def find_components(matrix, n, m):
    visited = [[False] * m for _ in range(n)]
    components = 0

    def dfs(i, j, val):
        if i < 0 or i >= n or j < 0 or j >= m or visited[i][j] or matrix[i][j] != val:
            return
        visited[i][j] = True
        dfs(i + 1, j, val)
        dfs(i - 1, j, val)
        dfs(i, j + 1, val)
        dfs(i, j - 1, val)

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(m):
            if not visited[i][j]:
                dfs(i, j, matrix[i][j])
                components += 1
    return components
